title: What's New
summary: Version 1.2.0 adds recorded metal price history, richer interactive charts, and useful refresh and photo improvements.

releases.title: Version 1.2.0 Beta
releases.summary: Historical metal prices, interactive chart improvements, and smoother everyday controls.

changes.title: Gold and silver price history
changes.body: Added a Price History page for exploring recorded gold and silver spot prices across one day, one week, one month, six months, one year, or all available history.

changes.title: Interactive charts
changes.body: Refined performance and price charts with clearer visuals and touch controls for reviewing values and dates across the timeline.

changes.title: Dashboard price refresh
changes.body: Pull down on the Dashboard to check for the latest published AurumStack spot prices.

changes.title: Photo deletion fix
changes.body: Attached photo thumbnails now disappear immediately after they are deleted from a holding.

releases.title: Version 1.1.0 Beta
releases.summary: Navigation, dashboard, holdings, information, and platform-specific improvements.

changes.title: UI improvements
changes.body: Refined the app layout with a cleaner bottom navigation, smoother tab highlighting, and a more polished black and gold AurumStack feel.

changes.title: Dashboard and holdings updates
changes.body: Improved the dashboard, tightened holding card spacing, and refined spot price cards so gold and silver are easier to scan at a glance.

changes.title: Calculator polish
changes.body: Updated the calculator presentation to make estimated values clearer while keeping the same simple calculation flow.

changes.title: Backup and privacy foundation
changes.body: Continued improving local-only tracking, backup and restore support, and privacy-focused app messaging for beta testers.

changes.title: What's New and announcements
changes.body: Added grouped update history and a remotely updated announcements section with saved offline content.

changes.title: Daily spot movement
changes.body: Spot price cards can show today's dollar and percent movement measured from the first AurumStack price update after 00:00 UTC.

changes.title: More native iPhone interactions
changes.body: Holding actions and photo source choices now use iPhone-style action sheets on iOS while preserving familiar Android controls.

changes.title: Legal and contact information
changes.body: Added clear pricing and financial disclaimers and refreshed the Contact Us page with friendlier support information.
